label: B25-RX-FIRMWARE-COMMAND-TRACE
title: Add bounded CPU-visible getc, dispatch and putc observability to the B25 monitor
writes: fpga/catapult_a10/boot/check_image_contract.py only for the new image/output contract
reads: T-005/T-001 full-SoC and vendor timing evidence

write_regions.boot.S: monitor, uart_getc, uart_putc, emit_rx_observation, observation variables and strings only; no DDR/calibration behavior change
write_regions.lcvex_catapult_soc_tb.sv: RX diagnostic parsing/expectations only; no vendor timing model change
write_regions.README/checker: document and verify the frozen rotating-page ABI

scope: Instrument the resident monitor without changing command semantics. Count valid uart_getc results and retain raw low 16 bits; count dispatches and retain command class/byte; count actual DATA stores and finite-wait drops in uart_putc. Read the frozen hardware observation offsets and emit one precisely formatted sub-64-byte page per autonomous observation. Startup and manual d retain RXDBG; the first autonomous page is also RXDBG, then autonomous calls rotate RXPATH/RXCPU/RXDBG without manual d advancing the page. Preserve p/PONG, ?/status, d/diagnostic and printable echo behavior.

software_packing.getc_event: bits31:16 valid-getc count, bits15:0 last raw DATA value
software_packing.dispatch_event: bits31:16 dispatch count, bits15:8 command class, bits7:0 command byte
software_packing.putc_event: bits31:16 successful DATA-write count, bits15:0 finite-wait drop count
software_packing.command_classes: 0 none, 1 ping, 2 status, 3 memory, 4 debug, 5 printable echo

acceptance.reset: All software observation variables are explicitly initialized at _start before first report.
acceptance.bounded_output:
Exact page formats are RXDBG %08X %08X
 (25 bytes), RXPATH %08X %08X %08X %08X
 (44 bytes), and RXCPU %08X %08X %08X %08X
 (43 bytes). Only one page is emitted per autonomous call; startup and manual d remain RXDBG and do not advance the autonomous page; the first periodic page remains RXDBG.
acceptance.semantics: After long empty polling, ?, p, d and Z each increment valid/dispatch exactly once with correct raw value/class/byte; successful TX writes and drops reconcile with expected output.
acceptance.image: boot image remains entirely below 0x10000 with stack [0xF000,0x10000), and image contract checker passes.
acceptance.regression: CAL-OK/CAL-WAIT/CAL-FAIL full-SoC and existing vendor-timed tests retain PONG/status/debug/echo behavior.
acceptance.no_fix: Do not alter command comparison, load width, retry limit or functional response path to make tests pass.

resource: Boot build and static checks are light. Obtain resource-lock local before Verilator/full-SoC; do not run concurrently with T-013 heavy validation. No GamePC/Quartus/JTAG/board action.
forbidden_regions: uart_getc command comparisons or uart_putc retry limit
